```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var PIECES_KEY     = 'pieces:experimenting';
  var EXPLORING_KEY  = 'pieces:exploring';
  var CB_KEY         = 'checklist:experimenting';
  var N              = 2;
  var AOI_OPTS       = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var CTX_OPTS       = ['', 'Local', 'Global'];
  var PRACTICALS     = ['Creating', 'Performing'];
  var INP = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var SEL = INP + 'cursor:pointer;';
  var TH  = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD  = 'padding:.25rem .2rem;';

  function blank() { return { name:'', composer:'', genre:'', aoi:'', context:'', practical:'' }; }
  function loadPieces(key, n) {
    var count = n || N;
    try { var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key))||[]; while(d.length<count)d.push(blank()); return d.slice(0,count); }
    catch(e) { return Array(count).fill(null).map(blank); }
  }
  var pieces = loadPieces(PIECES_KEY);
  // Practical exercise is fixed for EWM
  pieces[0].practical = 'Creating';
  pieces[1].practical = 'Performing';
  function savePieces() { try{localStorage.setItem(PIECES_KEY,JSON.stringify(pieces));}catch(e){} }
  savePieces();
  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

  // ── Upload timing / word-count helpers ────────────────────────────────────────
  var TH2 = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD2 = 'padding:.25rem .3rem;vertical-align:middle;';
  var INP2 = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var JUMP_BTN = 'background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:#5b9bd5;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted;font-family:inherit;';

  function fmtTime(s) { var m=Math.floor(s/60),r=s%60; return m+':'+(r<10?'0':'')+r; }

  function timeBar(secs, maxSecs) {
    var over = secs > maxSecs;
    var pct = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs,1) : 0;
    var barColor, timeColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; timeColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; timeColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+timeColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+fmtTime(secs)+'</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function wordBar(words, maxWords) {
    var over = words > maxWords;
    var pct = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords,1) : 0;
    var barColor, wordColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; wordColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; wordColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+wordColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+words+' words</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+maxWords+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function inlineOverWarning(secs, maxSecs) {
    return secs > maxSecs ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.72rem;margin-left:.4rem;">&#9888; over '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+'</span>' : '';
  }

  // ── EWM piece helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function ewmPieceDisplayText(idx) {
    var p = pieces[idx];
    var name = p && p.name;
    if (name) return esc(name);
    return idx === 0
      ? '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">Creating piece</em>'
      : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">Performing piece</em>';
  }

  window.ewmJumpPiece = function(idx) {
    var tracker = document.getElementById('piece-tracker');
    if (!tracker) return;
    var rows = tracker.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    var target = rows[idx];
    if (!target || target.style.display === 'none') return;
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight');
    void target.offsetWidth;
    target.classList.add('piece-row-highlight');
    setTimeout(function(){ target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight'); }, 2500);
  };

  function ewmPieceLink(idx) {
    return '<button onclick="ewmJumpPiece('+idx+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;" title="Jump to piece in repertoire">'+ewmPieceDisplayText(idx)+'</button>';
  }

  // ── EWM Upload 1: word counts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var EWM_U1_KEY = 'ewm-upload1-words';
  var ewmU1 = {sec1:'', sec2:''};
  try { var _eu1 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(EWM_U1_KEY)); if (_eu1) { ewmU1.sec1=_eu1.sec1||''; ewmU1.sec2=_eu1.sec2||''; } } catch(e) {}
  function saveEWMU1() { try{localStorage.setItem(EWM_U1_KEY,JSON.stringify(ewmU1));}catch(e){} }

  function renderEWMUpload1() {
    var c = document.getElementById('ewm-upload1-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var rows = [
      { key:'sec1', label:'Section 1 Creating', pieceIdx:0 },
      { key:'sec2', label:'Section 2 Performing', pieceIdx:1 }
    ];
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Section</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Recommended</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:8em;">Word count</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">'+row.label+': '+ewmPieceLink(row.pieceIdx)+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">~750</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" data-ewmu1key="'+row.key+'" value="'+esc(String(ewmU1[row.key]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    });
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var total = (parseInt(ewmU1.sec1)||0) + (parseInt(ewmU1.sec2)||0);
    h += wordBar(total, 1500);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-ewmu1key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { ewmU1[el.dataset.ewmu1key] = el.value; saveEWMU1(); renderEWMUpload1(); });
    });
  }

  // ── EWM Upload 2: audio times ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var EWM_U2_KEY = 'ewm-upload2-times';
  var ewmU2 = {cs_m:'',cs_s:'', c1_m:'',c1_s:'', c2_m:'',c2_s:'', c3_m:'',c3_s:'',
               ps_m:'',ps_s:'', p1_m:'',p1_s:'', p2_m:'',p2_s:'', p3_m:'',p3_s:''};
  try { var _eu2 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(EWM_U2_KEY)); if (_eu2) { Object.keys(ewmU2).forEach(function(k){ if(_eu2[k]!==undefined) ewmU2[k]=_eu2[k]; }); } } catch(e) {}
  function saveEWMU2() { try{localStorage.setItem(EWM_U2_KEY,JSON.stringify(ewmU2));}catch(e){} }

  function renderEWMUpload2() {
    var c = document.getElementById('ewm-upload2-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var groups = [
      { label:'Creating', pieceIdx:0, rows:[
        { label:'Stimulus',     mKey:'cs_m', sKey:'cs_s', rec:'0:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 1', mKey:'c1_m', sKey:'c1_s', rec:'1:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 2', mKey:'c2_m', sKey:'c2_s', rec:'1:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 3', mKey:'c3_m', sKey:'c3_s', rec:'1:20' }
      ]},
      { label:'Performing', pieceIdx:1, rows:[
        { label:'Stimulus',     mKey:'ps_m', sKey:'ps_s', rec:'0:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 1', mKey:'p1_m', sKey:'p1_s', rec:'1:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 2', mKey:'p2_m', sKey:'p2_s', rec:'1:20' },
        { label:'Experiment 3', mKey:'p3_m', sKey:'p3_s', rec:'1:20' }
      ]}
    ];
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Section</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:7em;">Recommended</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    groups.forEach(function(grp) {
      h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
        +'<td colspan="4" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">'
        +grp.label+' — '+ewmPieceLink(grp.pieceIdx)
        +'</td></tr>';
      grp.rows.forEach(function(row) {
        h += '<tr>'
          +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;font-size:.82rem;">'+row.label+'</td>'
          +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">'+row.rec+'</td>'
          +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-ewmu2key="'+row.mKey+'" value="'+esc(String(ewmU2[row.mKey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
          +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-ewmu2key="'+row.sKey+'" value="'+esc(String(ewmU2[row.sKey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
          +'</tr>';
      });
    });
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var totalSecs = 0;
    ['cs_m','c1_m','c2_m','c3_m','ps_m','p1_m','p2_m','p3_m'].forEach(function(k){ totalSecs += (parseInt(ewmU2[k])||0)*60; });
    ['cs_s','c1_s','c2_s','c3_s','ps_s','p1_s','p2_s','p3_s'].forEach(function(k){ totalSecs += (parseInt(ewmU2[k])||0); });
    h += timeBar(totalSecs, 10*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-ewmu2key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { ewmU2[el.dataset.ewmu2key] = el.value; saveEWMU2(); renderEWMUpload2(); });
    });
  }

  function buildSel(field, opts, val, row) {
    var h = '<select data-row="'+row+'" data-field="'+field+'" style="'+SEL+'">';
    opts.forEach(function(o){ h+='<option value="'+esc(o)+'"'+(val===o?' selected':'')+'>'+(o||'—')+'</option>'; });
    return h+'</select>';
  }

  function renderTracker() {
    var c = document.getElementById('piece-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI','Context','Practical exercise'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<N; r++) {
      h += '<tr>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(pieces[r][f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel('aoi', AOI_OPTS, pieces[r].aoi, r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:7em;">'+buildSel('context', CTX_OPTS, pieces[r].context, r)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:9em;color:#777;font-size:.82rem;padding-left:.4rem;">'+PRACTICALS[r]+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        pieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        savePieces(); runAutoChecks();
        renderEWMUpload1(); renderEWMUpload2();
      });
    });
  }

  function initAutoIndicators() {
    var headings = document.querySelectorAll('h2');
    var repEl = null;
    headings.forEach(function(h) {
      if (/repertoire/i.test(h.textContent)) repEl = h;
    });
    if (!repEl) return;
    var el = repEl.nextElementSibling;
    while (el && el.tagName !== 'H2' && el.tagName !== 'HR') {
      el.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.classList.add('auto-check');
        cb.style.display = 'none';
        cb.disabled = true;
        var lbl = li.querySelector('label');
        if (lbl) lbl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        li.style.cursor = 'default';
        var ind = document.createElement('span');
        ind.className = 'auto-indicator';
        li.insertBefore(ind, li.firstChild);
      });
      el = el.nextElementSibling;
    }
  }

  function setCheck(substr, val, error) {
    document.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li){
      if (li.textContent.indexOf(substr) > -1) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.checked = !!val;
        var ind = li.querySelector('.auto-indicator');
        if (ind) {
          ind.classList.remove('auto-checked', 'auto-error');
          if (error) ind.classList.add('auto-error');
          else if (val) ind.classList.add('auto-checked');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function runAutoChecks() {
    var ewmAOIs  = pieces.map(function(p){return p.aoi;}).filter(Boolean);
    var exploring = loadPieces(EXPLORING_KEY, 4);
    var expAOIs  = exploring.map(function(p){return p.aoi;}).filter(Boolean);

    setCheck('two different areas of inquiry', new Set(ewmAOIs).size >= 2);

    var ewmCtxs = pieces.map(function(p){ return p.context; }).filter(Boolean);
    setCheck('local and global', ewmCtxs.indexOf('Local') > -1 && ewmCtxs.indexOf('Global') > -1);

    var allAOIs = new Set(ewmAOIs.concat(expAOIs));
    var fourOK  = allAOIs.has('1') && allAOIs.has('2') && allAOIs.has('3') && allAOIs.has('4');
    var fourError = !fourOK && ewmAOIs.length >= N && expAOIs.length >= 3;
    setCheck('four areas of inquiry', fourOK, fourError);
  }

  var boxes;
  function saveCheckboxes() {
    try{localStorage.setItem(CB_KEY,JSON.stringify((boxes||[]).map(function(b){return b.checked;})));}catch(e){}
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    renderTracker();
    initAutoIndicators();
    boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'))
      .filter(function(cb){ return !cb.classList.contains('auto-check'); });
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.removeAttribute('disabled'); cb.style.cursor='pointer'; });
    try {
      var sv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CB_KEY));
      if (Array.isArray(sv)) boxes.forEach(function(cb,i){ if(sv[i]!==undefined)cb.checked=!!sv[i]; });
    } catch(e) {}
    runAutoChecks();
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', saveCheckboxes); });

    renderEWMUpload1();
    renderEWMUpload2();
  });

  window.resetEWMChecklist = function() {
    if (boxes) { boxes.forEach(function(b){b.checked=false;}); saveCheckboxes(); }
  };
})();
</script>
<style>
.task-list input[type="checkbox"] { width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 0.4em; }
.auto-indicator {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid #bbb;
  background: #f0ede8;
  margin-right: 0.4em;
  vertical-align: middle;
  position: relative;
  top: -1px;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked {
  border-color: #2e7d32;
  background: #2e7d32;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked::after {
  content: '✓';
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .6em;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.auto-indicator.auto-error {
  border-color: #c0392b;
  background: #c0392b;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-error::after {
  content: '✗';
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .6em;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
@keyframes piece-row-pulse {
  0%   { background-color: transparent; }
  15%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  75%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  100% { background-color: transparent; outline: none; }
}
.piece-row-highlight { animation: piece-row-pulse 2.5s ease-out forwards; }
</style>
<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
<button onclick="resetEWMChecklist();" style="font-size:0.78rem;padding:0.25rem 0.7rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#888;cursor:pointer;">Reset checklist</button>
</div>
```

---

## Repertoire

<div id="piece-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;overflow-x:auto;"></div>

- [ ] At least **two different areas of inquiry** are represented across all pieces
- [ ] All **four areas of inquiry** are covered between Exploring and Experimenting
- [ ] Both **contexts** are covered: local and global

---

## Creating experiments

### Commentary

- [ ] Rationale justifies the choice of source material and its connection to the area of inquiry ([EWM A](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Rationale explains how the source material will enable musical experimentation ([EWM A](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Commentary traces how the creating experiments developed over time ([EWM A](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Commentary explains the musical decisions made at each stage of experimentation ([EWM A](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Commentary evaluates what the experiments revealed about the style or technique ([EWM A](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-a,rt-explain))

### Practical experiments

- [ ] A **series of distinct experiments** is submitted — not just a single finished piece ([EWM B](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-b,rt-adapt))
- [ ] Each experiment reflects a deliberate musical decision, not just repetition ([EWM B](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-b,rt-adapt))
- [ ] The developing musical idea moves beyond simple replication of the source material ([EWM B](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-b,rt-adapt))
- [ ] Audio/visual evidence clearly demonstrates how the idea evolved across experiments ([EWM B](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-b,rt-adapt))

---

## Performing experiments

### Commentary

- [ ] Rationale justifies the choice of performing source material and area of inquiry ([EWM C](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-c,rt-explain))
- [ ] Commentary traces how performing approaches were developed and modified ([EWM C](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-c,rt-explain))
- [ ] Commentary evaluates what the performing experiments revealed ([EWM C](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-c,rt-explain))

### Practical experiments

- [ ] A **series of distinct performing experiments** is submitted ([EWM D](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-d,rt-adapt))
- [ ] Performing experiments develop a genuine musical approach beyond surface imitation ([EWM D](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-d,rt-adapt))
- [ ] Audio evidence demonstrates clear progression across the performing experiments ([EWM D](../resources/rubrics.html#ewm-d,rt-adapt))

---

## Submission

**Upload 1 — Experimentation report:**

```{=html}
<div id="ewm-upload1-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] Written report is within **1,500 words** (visual evidence and bibliography not counted)
- [ ] Report is in two sections: Section 1 Creating, Section 2 Performing
- [ ] Track list included with exact timings for all excerpts in Upload 2

**Upload 2 — Audio evidence:**

```{=html}
<div id="ewm-upload2-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] Total audio does not exceed **10 minutes**
- [ ] 20 second excerpt of the stimulus for creating included 
- [ ] Three related creating excerpts submitted *(each approx. 1 minute, 20 seconds)*
- [ ] 20 second excerpt of the stimulus for performing included 
- [ ] Three related performing excerpts submitted *(each approx. 1 minute, 20 seconds)*
- [ ] Compiled in order: creating excerpts first, then performing excerpts
- [ ] Audio quality is sufficient for full assessment of the experiments
- [ ] Each excerpt is labelled to match the commentary in the report
